body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Edifier showcased its iPod, iPhone and MP3 docking station 'Luna5 Encore' at CES 2010.
This all-in-one audio system incorporates unique vibration and resonance control technologies coupled with low frequency porting and mid-range tuned cavities for smoother cleaner audio.
It features digital FM radio, Aux input allows MP3 players and MP3 enabled cellular phones to be connected and played and full range universal switch-mode power supply.
It is available in white and black.
